Hi Sam —

We had the slot at 10:00 AM PT but didn't see you join. No problem — these things happen. I've dropped a couple of immediate troubleshooting tips below in case you want to try quickly before we reschedule: 

Quick checks (if you're trying a request now):
- Confirm you have an API key in the dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/account/keys
- Set it as an env var (Bash): export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx
- Minimal curl test: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/ping
- If you see 401, double-check key and timezone on the request client; for CORS errors run the request server-side or use our CLI proxy.

If you prefer we rebook, here are two options:
- Tue Jun 1, 11:00 AM PT
- Wed Jun 2, 9:00 AM PT

You can also pick another time on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/stephanie_nguyen. Marcus will join as SE for any SDK or architecture questions.

Apologies if there was any calendar invite issue — I forwarded your confirmation below for context.

Thanks,
Stephanie
